jobs.description: This is what you will doYou will be working at a large company in Zoetermeer where different types of meat products are produced that the whole of the Netherlands eats on their sandwich every morning. jobs.description: As an experienced forklift driver, you will work for a specialist in the fruit and vegetable (AGF) sector. With your precise way of working, you ensure that the right products end up in the right place. If you see a fellow forklift driver moving pallets, you will naturally lend a helping hand. Teamwork and collegiality are therefore highly valued within the company. For this position, it is important that you are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 10°C.Responsibilities:- Carrying out quality checks in a correct and careful manner- Moving and storing goods in the correct locations- Working in a structured and safe way with the forkliftYou will work weekdays from 06:30 to 16:00 (with possible overtime when required) and are expected to work one Saturday per month. Overtime worked above 38 hours per week is paid at 135% of the regular hourly rate.- Experience as a forklift driver- Good command of both Dutch and English- Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment- Full-time availability and looking for a permanent position- Own transportation- Living in or around Rotterdam, The Hague, Zoetermeer, or Bleiswijk
